command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; echo '===FRANKENSTEIN_MAIN==='; git ls-remote https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}'; echo '===VOICE_UNITS==='; for u in frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-gespraech.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; do echo UNIT=$u; systemctl --user show "$u" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager || true; done; echo '===VOICE_PROCESSES==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,cmd | grep -E '[v]oice_full_runtime|[v]oice_777_runtime|[g]espraechsmodus.py|[r]ealtime_gespraech|[g]espraech_loop|[f]rankenstein.*gespraech|[v]oice_host_live_client|[v]oice_host_777_live_client' || true; echo '===ESTABLISHED_NETWORK==='; PIDS=$(for u in frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-gespraech.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; do systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true; done | grep -E '^[1-9][0-9]*$' | paste -sd, -); if [ -n "${PIDS:-}" ]; then ss -tnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "pid=($(echo $PIDS | tr ',' '|'))[,)]" || true; fi; echo '===RECENT_VOICE_JOURNAL==='; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -u frankenstein-gespraech.service --since '-3 min' --no-pager -n 120 2>/dev/null | tail -120 || true; echo '===DROPINS==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service 2>/dev/null | tail -80 || true; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service 2>/dev/null | tail -80 || true
